name: biomcp
description: Read-only biomedical search via the biomcp-cli PyPI distribution and biomcp command.
long_description: BioMCP packages the existing Rust CLI and MCP server as a local read-only bundle. Install biomcp-cli from PyPI; the unrelated biomcp PyPI package is not this project.

tools.name: biomcp
tools.description: Run one read-only BioMCP CLI command. Prefer the bounded typed tools when they fit. Use this escape hatch for discovery, enrichment, study analytics, and other read-only commands. Start with `biomcp list` or `biomcp list <entity>` for compact command discovery; use `biomcp skill list` for worked workflows. Set `json` for structured output. Binary downloads, local filesystem operations, updates, and mutations are rejected.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search one supported biomedical entity with typed inputs, bounded pagination, and optional JSON output.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Retrieve one biomedical record and optional named text sections with typed inputs. Binary assets remain CLI-only.

tools.name: variant_normalize_car
tools.description: Normalize 1-50 versioned RefSeq HGVS values through the read-only ClinGen Allele Registry.

tools.name: variant_erepo
tools.description: Retrieve versioned ClinGen ERepo expert assertions for one CAid or a bounded CAid batch.

tools.name: gene_cspec
tools.description: Retrieve ClinGen CSpec manifests or bounded pages from one captured exact document.

tools.name: variant_articles
tools.description: Retrieve compact literature shortlists for 1-10 structured variant identities.

oncokb_token.title: OncoKB Token
oncokb_token.description: Optional. Enables OncoKB therapy and level evidence for variant oncokb <id>.

disgenet_api_key.title: DisGeNET API Key
disgenet_api_key.description: Optional. Enables DisGeNET scored association sections for genes and diseases.

s2_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API Key
s2_api_key.description: Optional. Improves reliability for article TLDR, citation, reference, and recommendation calls.
